title: An OpenCode account OpenCode lists no provider for is logged out, skipped for review, and a failing run names OpenCode's error
description: With a stand-in OpenCode 2.x on PATH and two OpenCode reviewer accounts that both hold an opencode/auth.json: the one opencode auth list shows no authenticated provider for reads as logged out on the Workers page and is passed over, the review is chosen on the other, and a headless run that exits 1 with its error as a JSON event on stdout fails naming that error, not only its exit code.
